optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Senior Project Manager, Airport Baggage Systems

professionalSummary.text: Senior Project Manager with 5+ years of experience managing airport baggage system installations as project manager of record, including signing project charters and milestone certificates for three installations between 2020-2025.
professionalSummary.witness: Senior Project Manager and project manager of record on three airport baggage system installations for a systems integrator between 2020 and 2025, signing the project charters and the contractual milestone certificates for each; before that, three years as a site project engineer on two installations.

professionalSummary.text: Holds current PMP credential since 2019, with credential number and registry entry available for verification.
professionalSummary.witness: PMP credential held since 2019 and current; credential number and the institute's registry entry available for verification.

experienceHighlights.text: Managed project budgets under business-delegated limits for three airport baggage installations, with monthly cost reports filed to the head of projects.
experienceHighlights.witness: Held the project budget for each installation under the business's delegated limits, with the monthly cost reports to the head of projects filed in the project folders.

experienceHighlights.text: Directed site project engineers through documented cut-over plans and fallback checklists during night-time cut-overs with airport operators at three sites.
experienceHighlights.witness: Ran the night-time cut-overs with the airport operators under the business's cut-over method, directing the site project engineers through the cut-over plan and the fallback checklist at each of the three sites.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented project boundaries, risks, and hand-over conditions at each milestone, submitted with milestone certificates.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the project boundary statement, the risk register and the hand-over conditions submitted with each milestone certificate.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Verified work samples include signed project charters, milestone certificates, cut-over plans with fallback checklists, and PMP credential certificate with project folder references.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: one signed project charter, two signed milestone certificates, one cut-over plan with its fallback checklist and the credential certificate, with the project folder references as a verification trail.

skills.text: Project management, airport baggage systems installation, budget management, cut-over execution, risk documentation.
skills.witness: Senior Project Manager and project manager of record on three airport baggage system installations for a systems integrator between 2020 and 2025, signing the project charters and the contractual milestone certificates for each; before that, three years as a site project engineer on two installations.
